limits: These are continuous-vowel lexical ownership estimates, not isolated silent-gap measurements.
Previous-word release changes are explicit coupled ownership decisions; they are not renderer clamps or unexplained truncation.
Original source remains authoritative. Estimated-vocal phone paths aid lexical interpretation but can contain separation leakage and noncausal pre/post-smear.

Fresh restricted and broad MMS are one family; fresh conditioned and unprompted Whisper are one family. Original/stem applications are not independent model votes. Tiny-crop unprompted hallucinations are retained as rejected evidence.
512-sample STFT smear is about±5.8ms;2048-sample smear is about±23.2ms. Fine hops or exact sample encoding do not imply equally precise phonetics.
Low-confidence cases require reconciliation with coordinating acoustic review; no blanket earliest-model or uniform anticipation choice is implied.
scope: Nineteen individually reviewed joined-vowel and sonorant onsets:11 selected onset changes,8 prior-word coupled release changes,8 retained onsets. All27 cue-final lexical endpoints and neutral reading holds remain unchanged.
